job_description: We are seeking an enthusiastic AI/ML Intern to join our applied intelligence team. In this role, you will assist in training and evaluating machine learning models, cleaning datasets using Pandas and NumPy, and building text processing pipelines with Python and Scikit-learn. Familiarity with PyTorch or TensorFlow, Git version control, and basic Docker containerization is a plus.

Our analytics department is looking for a Data Analyst Intern. You will query relational databases using SQL, build automated reporting dashboards in Power BI and Excel, and conduct exploratory data analysis using Python and Pandas. Strong analytical thinking and communication skills are required.

Join our core engineering squad as a Software Engineering Intern. You will collaborate on developing backend microservices in Python or Java, write clean unit tests, manage codebase versions with Git and GitHub, and participate in code reviews. Exposure to FastAPI, Docker, and relational databases is desirable.

We are looking for a Data Science Intern to help analyze healthcare datasets. You will be building predictive models with Scikit-learn, manipulating large tabular data with Pandas and NumPy, writing SQL queries for data extraction, and presenting experimental findings.

We are hiring a Python Developer Intern to develop web APIs and automation scripts. The ideal candidate has solid programming skills in Python, experience with Flask or FastAPI web frameworks, knowledge of SQL databases, and familiarity with Git for collaborative coding.

Join our management consulting team as a Business Analyst Intern. You will collect business requirements, analyze operational data in Excel and Power BI, create workflow diagrams, and write SQL queries to validate transactional metrics.

Looking for a creative Web Developer Intern passionate about modern web technologies. You will build responsive frontend interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React. Familiarity with Node.js backend integrations and Git version control is a strong advantage.

Our robotics research lab is hiring a Junior Machine Learning Intern. You will work on computer vision and deep learning tasks using PyTorch, OpenCV, and Python. Experience with NumPy arrays, data augmentation, and Linux/Git environments is beneficial.

We are seeking a QA/Software Testing Intern to help ensure product quality. Responsibilities include writing automated test scripts in Python, testing REST APIs with Postman, documenting bugs on GitHub, and verifying database records with SQL.

Join our data infrastructure team as a Data Engineering Intern. You will assist in building ETL data pipelines with Python and SQL, containerizing ingestion workers with Docker, and monitoring cloud storage buckets on AWS or Azure.
